in_arabic.name: عزهرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: The one who cultivates or gardens. This name is derived from the word 'azr' which means 'to cultivate' or 'to garden'. It is also the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her beautiful gardens.
